# Obfuscated push/merge/api forms that the hook must block (QA round 2, findings N2).
gi""t push origin main
g\it push origin main
git pu""sh origin main
git p\ush origin main
gh p\r merge 1
git $(echo push) origin main
git `echo push` origin main
git${IFS}push origin main
G=git; $G push origin main
echo push origin main | xargs git
printf 'push\norigin\nmain' | xargs git
git -c alias.p=push p origin main
git -c alias.p=push p origin HEAD:refs/heads/main
git config alias.p push
git {push,status} origin main
git $'push' origin main
git -C . -c alias.p=push p origin main
GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=alias.p GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=push git p origin main
gh alias set m 'pr merge'
"git" push origin main
env git push origin main
bash -c "g\it pu\sh origin main"
